notes: Framework's own items: the shared line families every Phobos mod uses (Framework 0.57.0) and the Rivetline process water tanks (Framework 0.58.0). The gas line moved here from Manufacturing and the S3 tank from Shipbreaker with their identities, prices, bills and stock unchanged; the process-water line and the S2 tank are new. Pipes are ordinary supplies; the tanks are equipment on Shipbreaker's pattern, the S2, S4 and S5 derived from the S3 through the shared size ladder.

PhobosProcessSilo.notes: Rivetline S3 Process Water Silo, 3 x 3, 240 kg dry (moved from Shipbreaker 0.53.0 unchanged); the S2, S4 and S5 follow through the ladder.

PhobosPropellantLine.notes: Fennmark gas line (moved from Manufacturing 0.22.0 unchanged): ordinary pipe supply, sold in lots of the supplies size at the supplies chance floor (chance 0 leaves the floor to decide).

PhobosProcessWaterLine.notes: Process-water line: the gas line's twin for water, at the same price, bills and stock.

PhobosConveyorBelt.notes: Rivetline conveyor belt (Framework 0.61.0): a 4 kg segment of steel frame, rollers and belting, priced above its steel (scrap steel is 3.6 cr/kg) and sold with the lines in lots of the supplies size. Repair takes a steel scrap; dismantling returns the whole segment as retained waste, so it loses value against selling it whole.

offerTemplates.notes: K-Leg supply kiosk sells broken tanks, as it did under Shipbreaker.
San Diego Halvorson sells new tanks.
Venus scrap kiosk sells broken tanks.

regional.notes: Supplies reach the regional kiosks through the expanded merchants at the supplies floor. Drain canisters reach every region at 0.65 and the expanded merchants at the supplies floor.

PhobosLineDrainCanister.notes: Rivetline D20 drain canister (Framework 0.63.0): a 20 litre lined can for draining lines, sold with the lines at every general market in lots of 16. It never stacks, since each canister records what it holds.

worldLoot.notes: The S3 keeps the same odds as each of Shipbreaker's eleven families (0.05 / 11), three in four broken, after the economy audit of 5 October 2026 cut that roll. The S2, S4 and S5 are not found.

factionKiosks.notes: Framework's lines and water tanks at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks for scrip, every tank size with its family. Tier rule (docs/development/faction-kiosk-stock.md): supplies, pipe and line Neutral, like the game's tools and cladding; equipment under 10,000 credits Warm, like its nav modules; nothing at Honored.
